covers: The Sega 315-5313 video display processor of the Mega Drive and Genesis as a chip

entries.name: Sega 315-5313 MD VDP
entries.description: The Mega Drive and Genesis video chip: tile planes, sprites, a colour RAM palette and DMA, driven through a data port, a control port and an HV counter.
entries.behaviour: Its address block holds the data port (0x00), the control port (0x04), the HV counter (0x08) and the sound chip port (0x10). Video memory is reached by a two-word control command that sets a code and an address, then data port accesses. Registers 0x00 to 0x17 are set by control words; the FIFO is not modelled and DMA is instant.

handlers.vdp_r: read the data port, the control port (status) or the HV counter, by offset
handlers.vdp_w: write the data port, the control port or the sound chip port, by offset
handlers.vram_w: write one word of VRAM directly, outside the ports
handlers.irq_ack: interrupt acknowledge: clears a pending vertical interrupt while register 0x01 bit 5 is set, else a horizontal one while register 0x00 bit 4 is set
handlers.psg_w: write the sound chip behind the VDP
